claims.text: Alila Fort Bishangarh is a former warrior fort reimagined as a retreat, perched high above the Rajasthani landscape.

findings.quote: Perched high above the Rajasthani landscape, Alila Fort Bishangarh is a 236-year-old warrior fort thoughtfully reimagined as a tranquil retreat.
findings.note: The page describes a warrior fort reimagined as a retreat, perched high above the landscape.

claims.text: The fort is located between Jaipur and Delhi.

findings.quote: Tucked between Jaipur and Delhi, the fort invites you to slow down
findings.note: The page places the fort between Jaipur and Delhi.

claims.text: The restoration of the fort used traditional Rajasthani construction techniques with local stone, combined with contemporary architecture.

findings.quote: The restoration of the ancient fort harnessed traditional Rajasthani construction techniques using local stone, combining it with contemporary architecture to create a uniquely relaxing environment.
findings.note: All elements of the claim match this sentence.

claims.text: The restoration and conversion into a hotel took 10 years.

findings.quote: the restoration and conversion into a hotel was a 10-year process
findings.note: The review states the restoration and conversion took 10 years.

claims.text: Rooms and suites combine traditional Jaipur Gharana architecture with contemporary design.

findings.quote: Traditional Jaipur Gharana architecture and contemporary design come together in our 87 idyllic, inviting, opulent rooms and suites.
findings.note: The rooms and suites are described as combining Jaipur Gharana architecture with contemporary design.

claims.text: The suites have day beds and large bay windows.

findings.quote: our suites boast day beds and large bay windows
findings.note: The page says the suites have day beds and large bay windows.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite is a top-floor suite with mountain and countryside views and a private terrace.

findings.quote: Step inside this 98 sq m top-floor suite, furnished with one king bed and boasting mountain and countryside views, a private terrace, and a separate sitting area.
findings.note: The Presidential Suite listing confirms the top floor, the mountain and countryside views, and the private terrace.

claims.text: Arrival is at the Haveli, a modern house where the spa, pool, gym and kids club are located.

findings.quote: Your first stop is the Haveli, a modern house inspired by the traditional villas of Rajasthan, where the spa, pool, gym, and kids club are located.
findings.note: The review names the Haveli as the arrival point and says it houses the spa, pool, gym and kids club.

claims.text: Play Alila offers younger guests storytelling, games and locally inspired arts and crafts.

findings.quote: For younger guests, Play Alila offers plenty of options for fun, including storytelling, games and locally inspired arts and crafts.
findings.note: All three listed activities are confirmed for younger guests.

claims.text: Activities include morning safaris, midday helicopter adventures and sunset horseback riding.

findings.quote: With morning safaris, midday helicopter adventures, sunset horseback riding and much more, there’s something for just about everyone.
findings.note: All three activities named in the claim are listed.

claims.text: Nazaara specializes in traditional Rajput hunter-style cooking over sandpits and open fire pits.

findings.quote: The restaurant also specializes in traditional Rajput hunter-style cooking, where food is prepared over sandpits and open fire pits.
findings.note: This is stated in the Nazaara description on the dining page.

claims.text: Amarsar, the all-day restaurant, is set in former royal living quarters.

findings.quote: Dine like royalty in former royal living quarters. Savour speciality dishes with options to suit any palate. Much acclaimed as an excellent family restaurant in Jaipur, this all-day dining venue
findings.note: The Amarsar description confirms both the all-day dining and the former royal living quarters.

claims.text: The infinity pool has views of the surrounding mountains, greenery and Fort Bishangarh.

findings.quote: Enjoy a refreshing dip in the infinity pool, which offers views of the surrounding mountains, lush greenery and Fort Bishangarh.
findings.note: The page confirms the infinity pool's views of the mountains, greenery and the fort.

claims.text: The Pool Villa is a villa suite with a temperature-controlled plunge pool.

findings.quote: Spread out amid 93 sq m is this spacious villa suite with temperature controlled plunge pool
findings.note: The Pool Villa listing describes a villa suite with a temperature-controlled plunge pool.

claims.text: A ride through a forgotten tributary of the Madhuveni ends with high tea by a ruined temple.

findings.quote: Embark on a thrilling ride with Alila Fort Bishangarh through a forgotten tributary of Madhuveni, ending in a serene high tea by a ruined temple.
findings.note: The page describes the ride through the tributary ending in high tea by a ruined temple.

claims.text: Spa Alila is set in a converted former cellar space.

findings.quote: The scent of jasmine and essential oils fills the air in our beautifully converted former cellar space
findings.note: This appears in the Spa Alila description and confirms the converted former cellar.

claims.text: The Kachchawa Deck and Lounge has been part of the fort from its origin and was used by noblemen to share state secrets.

findings.quote: Kachchawa Deck & Lounge has been a part of the fort from its origin. The room was used by noblemen to share and whisper state secrets to one another.
findings.note: Both the origin and the noblemen's use of the room for state secrets are confirmed.

claims.text: Guests take a jeep up to the top of the hill to check in.

findings.quote: and then you take a jeep up to the top of the hill to check in.
findings.note: The review says guests take a jeep up the hill to check in.

claims.text: Jaipur International Airport is 71 kilometers from the hotel.

findings.note: The transportation page lists Jaipur International Airport at 71 km.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited nightlife and external dining options nearby.
